datasets.title: Somalia Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Somalia Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/somalia_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Somalia to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) framework. Survey results were spatially mapped and compiled into monthly geographic datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) for 2021, representing population-level food insecurity impact assessments.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity severity levels across geographic areas.
